acceptance_criteria.criterion: The status table has a 4th column header (empty or visually-hidden "Actions" label).
Each repository row has a 4th cell with an "Open" button styled as `btn btn-secondary btn-sm`.
Clicking the "Open" button calls `api.workspaces.openGithubDesktop(projectId, wid, repoId)`.
If the API call fails, an error toast is shown with the error message.
The existing `updateStatusTable()` function continues to work correctly (badge update at cell index 2 is unaffected by the new column at index 3).
